## Commerce Vision

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/v5/pay-later/commerce-vision/au/): PayPal Pay Later (Pay in 4) is a short-term installment product that provides eligible PayPal customers the option to split purchases into 4 interest-free payments.
